MECHANISM: Locally refined Muon-only cooldown

HYPOTHESIS: A 58% Muon cooldown paired with the verified 55% AdamW cooldown will beat the best observed val_bpb of 0.986424.

INTENDED_EDIT: Decouple optimizer-group schedules, preserving AdamW’s 55% cooldown while beginning Muon’s linear cooldown at 42% training progress.

EVIDENCE: Muon cooldowns of 55%, 59%, and 60% produced val_bpb values of 0.986663, 0.986424, and 0.986574; local quadratic interpolation places the estimated minimum near 58%.
